name: EhrIdSystem
title: EHR id system
description: The identifier system a member's own FHIR endpoint (`connectionType` `hl7-fhir-rest`) writes the member's openEHR `ehr_id` in when it is asked by identifier, in the registry document in FHIR form. Such an endpoint carries it once. No element of FHIR R4 `Endpoint` names it.
